messages.subject: For Makko DeFilippo | External affairs, stakeholder strategy and copper growth
messages.body:
Dear Ero Copper Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Makko DeFilippo, President and Chief Executive Officer, and the External Affairs & Strategy leadership team.

Ero Copper's growth in Brazil places external affairs, government relationships, community confidence and disciplined operating execution close to long-term value creation. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of external affairs, government relations, social performance and mining execution might support Ero Copper's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Ero Copper.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
